title: Supply Reconnection Charges for Self-Installed Units, Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
On a company-elected cash offer under Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts, a supply reconnection charge pays for the connection parts the homeowner's installer fits to the like unit:

| Item | Parts replaced | Supply reconnection charge |
|---|---|---|
| water heater | supply connectors and relief discharge line | 95.00 |
| heating system or cooling system | refrigerant line set or flue connector | 160.00 |
| any other item | — | nothing |

It is added to the company-elected cash basis as a flat dollar amount, never compounded, and the basis so obtained is compared with the remaining item and aggregate benefits without being rounded first. On such an offer this addition takes the place of a supplemental allowance.

*Hypothetical:* a company-elected offer for a central air conditioning unit carries a 160.00 supply reconnection charge; one for a dishwasher carries none.
